race.comment: TOP LINER (9) broke the maiden in some style at Traralgon. She worked into it before the corner and drew right away. Clearly she has been looking for ground. No surprise on her breeding for that to occur. OFF'N'GAWN (10) is another who got out in trip and showed it benefitted her. She went forward in the run and kept going. That has been a good form race too. CASHEMCOWBOY (3) won a weak Mortlake mile maiden but it was first up so he obviously needed ground. Will get a soft run but might want it soft. KING KAUFFO (8) has wanted this sort of ground. Won't be doing much work from the draw. RUTHLESS SOUL (11) is certainly bred to want 2000m plus. She could improve on the solid win two weeks ago.
